title: Yellow Smoked Moroccan Turkey Tagine
description: A rich and comforting Moroccan dish featuring crispy turkey, smoked to perfection, with a blend of aromatic spices and vegetables, perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the smoked paprika, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the turkey breast, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the turkey breast until it is browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the tagine for 25 minutes, or until the turkey is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
